description: List the exact market names served per sport, with shape (moneyline, line, outcomes, yesno, labelled), period, and whether each is served prematch and live. Call it before passing markets to any odds tool; names must match in full, e.g. 'ML' not 'Match Winner', 'Totals' not 'Over/Under'. Omitting sport returns every sport (large).

fields.description: Optional comma-separated fields to keep per market (e.g. 'name,live')

name: get_markets
title: List market names
